title: Creepy Totems
description: Replaces the boring totem with a cute, vanilla-friendly miniature Creeper plushie!
body:
# 🟩 Creepy Totems — The Ultimate Creeper Clutch

Ever thought the Totem of Undying looked a bit too... boring? **Creepy Totems** completely redesigns the totem into a detailed, miniature plushie of Minecraft's most iconic monster: the **Creeper**. Save your hardcore world or clutch a 100-block drop with a mini-creeper in your hand!

---

## ✨ Features
* **Detailed 3D-Like Texture:** High-quality 16x pixel art designed to look like a miniature Creeper figure.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Fits perfectly with the default Minecraft art style (16x16 resolution). No mods or shaders required!
* **Optimized for First-Person:** Clean design that doesn't block your screen during intense PvP or clutch moments.

---

## 🛠️ Compatibility
This pack is 100% vanilla and standalone. It doesn't require OptiFine or any dependencies.

* **Resolution:** 16x16 (Vanilla style)
* **Versions:** Works on Minecraft 1.16 up to the latest version.

---

## 🚀 Installation
1. Download the `.zip` file.
2. Open Minecraft and go to `Options` > `Resource Packs` > `Open Pack Folder`.
3. Drag and drop the downloaded file into the folder.
4. Activate **Creepy Totems** in-game and move it to the top of your active list!

---

*Note: This is the initial release featuring the Creeper. Stay tuned for more classic hostile mobs in future updates!*
